chunks: And revelation was sent down to Noah, saying: 'None of your people will believe except those who have already believed, so do not grieve over what they are doing.'
ai.seo_question: What did Allah reveal to Prophet Noah regarding the belief of his people?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the concept of *al-Iman al-Mu'tamad* (firm faith), indicating that only those who had already internalized conviction would remain steadfast, while the rest were destined for disbelief due to their inherent disposition. It reassures Noah (AS) that his distress is unnecessary, as divine decree had already separated the sincere believers from the stubborn disbelievers, a theme often linked to the principle of *Taqdir* (divine predestination) in Shia theology. This assurance underscores the transition from Noah's earthly struggle to the eventual execution of the Flood as a divine judgment on those who rejected the truth despite clear signs.
